pages.text: Cutting knives are used to make $(l:items_blocks_machines/presses)Inscriber Name Press$(/l)es and $(l:items_blocks_machines/cable_anchor)Cable Anchor$(/l)s.$(br2)To craft a name press, right click the cutting knife and insert an ingot of metal, you will then have to type the name you wish to write onto the plate then simply extract the finished plate.
